driver-layers.title: Three layers, one of them yours
driver-layers.alt: Layer diagram: the application calls the hardware-agnostic ADS7952 driver, which builds 16-bit command frames and calls the CRTP SPI interface, which calls the one transfer method of the platform port you write, which drives the SPI bus of the ADS7952.
driver-layers.description: From top to bottom. Your application talks to one ADS7952<SpiType> object, whose public calls (listed from inc/ads7952.hpp) read channels, switch modes and program sequences, alarms and GPIOs. The core builds the 16-bit command words, keys every result on the channel address in DO15:12 and converts counts to volts. It reaches the bus through the CRTP SpiInterface (inc/ads7952_spi_interface.hpp), whose one method the platform port implements: a full-duplex transfer with chip select held low. Below it is the hardware.
